Mayor Bowser's 10-Year Progress Report: A Decade of Delivering

The report highlights the major milestones and transformative progress made during her three terms as Mayor of Washington, DC.

Read the full report.

Free Produce from DPR

FREE produce at DPR urban gardens:
  • Weekly from May - November 2026 (weather permitting) 
  • TUESDAYS at Edgewood
  • WEDNESDAYS and SATURDAYS at Lederer Gardens
  • THURSDAYS at Powell Communal Farm

Murals for DC 250

Celebrate DC’s story through public art!

The DC250 Mural Project will bring eight new murals to iconic locations across the District, with one mural in each ward. Created by DC-based artists, each piece will reflect the history, identity and spirit of the community it represents.
